<!-- Closes #N. or Part of #N. Then what changed and why, in plain words. -->

- [ ] Tests added or updated; `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] README's Limits updated if a behaviour changed (and example output is real output)
- [ ] The spec or an ADR updated if a decision changed
- [ ] `stele.md` changed? `stele compile` run, `stele.lock` and `.claude/rules/stele-rules.md` committed
